title: Bidirectional Mission Control & Human Intervention Verification Ledger
zero_bypass_invariant: USER ACTION -> VALIDATION -> MISSION GATE -> STATE TRANSITION -> EXECUTION/SCHEDULING -> EVIDENCE -> UI UPDATE

zero_bypass.evidence: All interventions pass through MissionControlEngine.execute_command; direct mutation of scheduler or swarm is strictly prohibited and architecturally separated.

idempotency_deduplication.evidence: Duplicate commands with identical idempotency_key return cached results without repeating state transitions or version bumps. Tested under single repeat and 10-command bursts.

sentinel_security_gate.evidence: Payloads attempting policy bypass ('bypass_sentinel', 'disable_security', 'rm -rf') are refused with SECURITY_BLOCK, logged in the audit ledger, and prevented from modifying mission state.

dag_topological_invariance.evidence: Task reordering checks forward and backward dependency constraints. Swapping a prerequisite after its dependent or a dependent before its prerequisite returns CONFLICT and preserves original order.

state_machine_determinism.evidence: Complete state transition matrix validated. Terminal states (CANCELLED, COMPLETED, FAILED) refuse all further transitions. Same-state transitions return INVALID_STATE.

optimistic_concurrency_locking.evidence: Commands specifying an outdated expected_mission_version return STALE and refuse execution, preventing race conditions or lost updates.

human_approval_gate.evidence: Tasks paused in PENDING_APPROVAL require explicit APPROVE or REJECT. Commands on non-pending tasks return INVALID_STATE. Approvals transition status to DONE and unblock dependents.

dynamic_priority_queue.evidence: Priority changes to CRITICAL, HIGH, NORMAL, LOW update task priority and scheduler ordering without altering DAG dependency structure.
